basic_info.description: This stunningly renovated 2BR/2BA residence, featuring over $82K in upgrades, plus a versatile bonus room, offers unparalleled city skyline views & a private, efficient layout as a coveted end unit. The bedrooms are thoughtfully separated by a spacious great room, with the expansive living area seamlessly opening to a private balcony offering sweeping views from Twin Peaks to Bay Bridge. The chef's kitchen boasts high-end SS appliances, sleek under-counter cabinets, a waterdrop system, and a custom i-Robot cabinet for added convenience. The primary suite features an ensuite bath & an impressive walk-in closet w custom California Closets organizers. The second bedroom is designed for maximum space, featuring built-in shelving and a queen-sized Murphy bed. The bonus room, ideal for a home office, is enhanced with smart lighting, controlled via the Hue app. Both bathrooms are stylishly remodeled with luxurious finishes. This residence truly checks all the boxes w motorized room-darkening roller shades, custom window screens, parking, and add'l storage onsite. Resort-style amenities include an outdoor pool, hot tub, BBQ courtyard, owner's lounge, private theater, fitness center, guest parkings & rooftop terrace w panoramic city views. Experience the best of South Beach living
